summary: FST Corp., a Taiwan-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of independent director Richard Qi Li effective April 16, 2026, with no stated disagreement. The board immediately appointed Houston Li to fill the independent director vacancy and reassigned committee roles. Mr. Houston Li is a VP at CBC Securities and COO of a Nasdaq-listed SPAC. The change appears orderly, with standard indemnification and no related-party transactions disclosed. This is a board-level resignation and replacement, not a routine circular, but it is not forced or abrupt; it is a structured transition, thus fitting 'Management Changes' where a directorship change is the event. The terms are straightforward with no controversy or activist element. What to watch: any subsequent filings detailing compensation or further governance shifts.
